bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
sha=2467fe6847f5ef9f42ff74ff595cfb23401d678d
w="$r/.worktrees/room-live-2467fe6"
f="$r/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-live-2467fe6
rollback=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-room-2467fe6
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 76
test -f "$f" || exit 45
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 81
candidate=$(docker image inspect "$tag" --format '{{.Id}}') || exit 51
old=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}') || exit 52
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 53
if test "$old" = "$candidate"; then echo ROOM_ALREADY_DEPLOYED; echo SOURCE_SHA="$sha"; exit 0; fi
current_hash=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.config-hash"}}')
expected_hash=$(docker compose -p deploy -f "$f" --project-directory "$r/deploy" config --hash gaybbs | awk '{print $NF}')
test -n "$current_hash" && test "$current_hash" = "$expected_hash" || exit 46
docker image tag "$old" "$rollback" || exit 54
docker image tag "$candidate" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 55
fail=63
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$f" --project-directory "$r/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1; then fail=61
else
 i=0
 while test "$i" -lt 12; do
  new=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null || :)
  running=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null || :)
  if test "$new" != "$candidate" || test "$running" != true; then fail=62; break; fi
  if docker logs --since 3m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY; then
   if test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.RestartCount}}')" = 0 && test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active; then
    echo ROOM_LIVE_DEPLOY_PASS; echo SOURCE_SHA="$sha"; exit 0
   else fail=64; break; fi
  fi
  i=$((i+1)); sleep 3
 done
fi
docker image tag "$rollback" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 70
docker compose -p deploy -f "$f" --project-directory "$r/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 71
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$old" || exit 72
echo ROOM_LIVE_DEPLOY_ROLLED_BACK
exit "$fail"
